finalists.label: Cytomegalovirus Colitis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of viral cytopathic inclusions and active colitis with ulcer, with no evidence against it.

finalists.label: Cytomegalovirus infection
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of viral cytopathic inclusions, but it is less specific than Cytomegalovirus Colitis as it does not account for the colitis findings.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of active colitis with ulcer and viral cytopathic inclusions, which are specific to Cytomegalovirus Colitis, decided the final comparison.
